audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave K'Sante or Skill for levels 2 through the first item while every why underneath said Aurora controls that stretch — win[5] said K'Sante while whys[5] and spikes[2] both say she owns the side lane.
audit.why: Packet chart reads Skill / Aurora x5 / K'Sante, the mirror audit explicitly says levels 2 and 3 should read Aurora, and the page's own prose agrees end to end.
audit.corrected: Rows 2 through first item set to Aurora in both layers with ratings dropped to 4/10; row 1 stays Skill and the 2-item row stays K'Sante.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why sold the Iceborn Gauntlet timing as a K'Sante fight window, contradicting spikes[2] on the same page.
audit.why: With Across the Veil up she blinks any all-in; one tank item does not close a 900-range poke gap. K'Sante's actual swing is the 2-item teamfight window.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why rewritten to the farm-and-scale instruction that matches spikes[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer had Aurora's W and E swapped and invented a root. It called the blink 'E blink' and described 'W exile + root-burst' at 6.
audit.why: Across the Veil is W (22/21/20/19/18s) — the leap, spirit realm and invisibility. The Weirding is E (15s) — a slow blast with a backward hop. Between Worlds is R (140/120/100s) — a shockwave plus a slowing zone she can teleport across. Nothing in her kit roots. The full layer separately called Twofold Hex 'her escape'; it is her 900-range poke on 9s.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected and named across whys[2], whys[4], spikes[1], spikes[2], wants.foe[1], wants.foe[2] and wants.you[0]; the fake root replaced with the real R slow zone; the escape re-attached to Across the Veil in the full layer.

audit.why: Her passive exorcises spirits from everything she damages and they heal her, so a long side-lane grind feeds her.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds buy added to report[8].t.

notes: Worst error here was slot-swapping: the content layer treated Across the Veil (W) as an E blink and invented a root at level 6 that exists nowhere in Aurora's kit — a player would hold Merc Treads/QSS for CC that never comes. Real R is Between Worlds, a shockwave plus a slowing zone she teleports across. Chart flipped rows 2-6 to Aurora as an atomic group in both layers, matching the packet and the page's own prose. focus.text is "Aurora Twofold Hex" (18 chars) and so still labels her poke as the tracked escape; under the 25-char skip threshold, needs a manual fix.
